feature: Lock sent envelopes. PrepareEnvelope must refuse (redirect to detail or read-only with a banner like 'This envelope has been sent. Void it and send a new one, or use Correct to change recipients.') when status != 'draft'; the store's updateEnvelope must ignore documents/recipients/fields/subject/message changes for non-draft envelopes; the Send button must not appear for non-drafts
why: ui_probe 2026-11-18: /prepare/env_hb_shuttle (status 'delivered', sent by Theo) opened the full wizard with Send enabled. Changing the message to 'PROBE EDIT AFTER SEND (January 21-23, 2027)' landed in server state, and the status stayed 'delivered'. Lever L09 needs sending to be irreversible: the old shuttle envelope's wrong dates must only be fixable by void plus a new envelope, and a careless early send must leave a permanent record.

feature: Immutable send snapshot. sendEnvelope writes envelope.sentSnapshot = {sentAt, subject, message, documents:[{id,name,fileSize,storedName}], recipients:[{id,name,email,role,routingOrder}]} once (never overwritten) and copies it into the history 'sent' event as `snapshot`. correctEnvelope's 'corrected' history event records `before` and `after` recipient arrays. voidEnvelope stores envelope.voidReason
why: ui_probe 2026-11-18: sending env_hb_photo through the wizard set status/sentAt and appended history {action:'sent', details:'Envelope sent to 2 recipient(s)'} with no snapshot. Correct overwrote recipients ('Jonah Reyes' became 'Jonah Reyes X') and logged only 'Envelope corrected - recipients updated'. Void kept the reason only inside history details. Without a snapshot, 'send to Greg, then Correct to Priya' looks the same as a correct first send, so the core L09 checks (C1-C3, C5, C9 in rubric.json) cannot be verified.
